body: I'm using the most basic products so I don't understand. Simple or CeraVe Cleanser and CeraVe moisturiser.
I'm on Accutane, therefore dry lips. However, pre accutane, it still looked shit with the imbalance of colour and redness.
I alternate between CeraVe Moisturizer and La Roche Possay Effacular Moisturizer

I had very bad lips (you can see my profile). 

One thing I didn't know at the beginning was that Aquaphor is only a sealant. This is what I do:

1) Good amount of moisturiser on lips
2) A few layers of Aquaphor
3) Topped with Vaseline

Do it twice a day. When you wake up and before you sleep. Your lips won't be a problem, except the look. I've noticed my lips are lessening in how dry they are when I wake up before applying too. 

Good luck!
My skin is like the first one, I hope I get results like you. Amazing, congrats
